summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the primary XML MIC matrix, the K. pneumoniae combination table, and linked database sequence/value adjudication from local material; remaining uncertainty is preserved as cautions rather than open rework.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML tables, extracted PDF text, OA package NXML/PDF, the supplementary mass-spectrum PDF text, and linked database/sequence catalogs were sufficient for worker-2/4/6 repair.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains a separate structural layer: XML/PDF/OA package/supplement/database assets are present; PDF table extraction is empty because XML tables are authoritative.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Final artifacts are present with source locators and reviewed provenance; validator readiness is not treated as scientific proof by itself.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP rows and most CAMP rows are source-verified against Table 1/Table 2; CAMP FA1 and dbAMP Pin2[14] mixed/misassigned activity text are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 2 peptide MIC rows and Table 3 FA1/Pin2[G] combination MIC/FIC rows are now row-level records with units, targets, conditions, and locators. Antibiotic-only rows are preserved as comparators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism output is bounded to phenotype, FIC combination context, and stability context; no direct killing mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains after source review; the closed ticket and remaining conflicts are explicit cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: FA1/E. coli MIC is 6.25 µg/mL in Table 2, while Results prose lists 12.5 µg/mL. Table 2 is retained and the conflict is recorded on act-013.
CAMP CAMPSQ10869 misassigns the 25 µg/mL FA1 value to K. pneumoniae; primary Table 2 assigns 25 µg/mL to P. aeruginosa and >50 µg/mL to K. pneumoniae.
dbAMP dbAMP_23275 aggregates Pin2[14] activities from multiple papers; only current-paper Table 2 bacterial MICs are source-reviewed here.
Hemolytic values are discussed from earlier references but no new paper-local hemolysis/cytotoxicity assay is present.

closed_rework_tickets.resolution: worker-2 activity table repair, worker-4 database adjudication, and worker-6 source-reviewed final adjudication completed from local material.
